system.description: Perform Medical Procedures: ritual mechanics on a Medical Check — (DEX + INS) or (INS + INS) — costed in zenit or IP at the GM's call. Minor (100z / 3 IP, DL 7) through Extreme (800z / 6 IP, DL 16): a set dislocation up to transplants and cures. The zenit is the practitioner's cost; a client's bill is the fee schedule (economy pass §1).
